name: Upload video
description: Uploads a video to TikTok's inbox or initiates a direct post using the Content Posting API. Direct posting requires a privacy level; the returned published flag reflects the requested mode, not confirmation that publishing completed.

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: Optional caption/title used when publish=true. Max 2200 UTF-16 runes.

is_aigc.title: Is Aigc
is_aigc.description: Set true to label the video as AI-generated content.

publish.title: Publish
publish.description: If true, attempts to publish after upload using the returned publish_id.

disable_duet.title: Disable Duet
disable_duet.description: Whether to disable duets on the video.

privacy_level.title: PrivacyLevel
privacy_level.description:
Privacy levels accepted by TikTok's Content Posting API.

The valid set for a given account is only discoverable via
``/v2/post/publish/creator_info/query/``. For unaudited apps only
``SELF_ONLY`` is permitted.

https://developers.tiktok.com/doc/content-posting-api-reference-direct-post

disable_stitch.title: Disable Stitch
disable_stitch.description: Whether to disable stitches on the video.

file_to_upload.title: FileUploadable

name.title: Name
name.description: The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service

s3key.title: S3Key
s3key.description: The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service.

mimetype.title: Mimetype
mimetype.description: The MIME type of the file

file_to_upload.description: Video file to upload to TikTok. Files are uploaded whole when possible and split into sequential TikTok-compatible chunks for larger videos. Supported formats include MP4, MOV, WEBM. Recommended aspect ratio 9:16.

disable_comment.title: Disable Comment
disable_comment.description: Whether to disable comments on the video.

chunk_size_bytes.title: Chunk Size Bytes
chunk_size_bytes.description: Optional chunk size for multipart uploads. Must be between 5,000,000 and 64,000,000 bytes and must produce a valid TikTok upload plan. Omit this to choose a safe chunk size automatically.

brand_content_toggle.title: Brand Content Toggle
brand_content_toggle.description: Set true if the content is a paid partnership promoting a third-party business.

brand_organic_toggle.title: Brand Organic Toggle
brand_organic_toggle.description: Set true if the content promotes the creator's own business.

video_cover_timestamp_ms.title: Video Cover Timestamp Ms
video_cover_timestamp_ms.description: Timestamp in milliseconds to use as video cover/thumbnail (e.g., 1000 for 1 second into video).

published.title: Published
published.description: Indicates whether the video was published (True if publish=true was used, False if uploaded to inbox only).

publish_id.title: Publish Id
publish_id.description: An identifier to track the posting action. Use this with TIKTOK_FETCH_PUBLISH_STATUS to check upload/publish status. Maximum length is 64 characters.

upload_url.title: Upload Url
upload_url.description: The presigned URL where the video file was uploaded. Valid for one hour after issuance. Maximum 256 characters.

upload_completed.title: Upload Completed
upload_completed.description: Indicates whether the video file was successfully uploaded to TikTok's servers.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
